The hu careers query returned OTP results plus third-party job boards (profession.hu, jooble, simplejob) but no employer-owned ATS for the other eight issuers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only OTP's employer-owned vacancy portal (karrier.otpbank.hu) was identified; the remaining issuers' careers URLs remain unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: 'jobs' and 'hiring' are two of the four run topics; without employer-owned ATS endpoints for eight of nine banks, hiring signal for this cell would be sourced almost entirely from aggregators, which is a lower-precision layer owned by a different cell.

negative_findings.result_summary: Board changes for these entities surfaced in this run via press coverage (e.g. Raiffeisen HU's 2026 board rotation) rather than via an HU-entity disclosure feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The origin layer for five of nine banks in this cell is partly foreign-parent IR, which sits outside the cell boundary as drawn and must be explicitly assigned to avoid a systematic blind spot.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated hu-language careers sweep per issuer using terms 'karrier', 'állás', 'nyitott pozíciók', 'csatlakozz hozzánk', 'karrieroldal' scoped to each bank domain; also probe the common ATS vendors HU banks use (SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Talentcloud, Nexum) by searching for '<bank> + jelentkezés + karrier'.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Explicitly assign parent-group IR/newsrooms to this cell or to a named neighbouring cell, and add group-level 'management changes' pages for the five foreign parents so HU subsidiary appointments are not missed.

coverage_gaps.description: The nine named banks are not the full HU systemic issuer set; state-owned and specialist institutions (MFB, Eximbank, Takarékbank legacy entities, Magyar Posta/ MBH-adjacent entities, Oberbank HU, Cetelem, Sberbank successor perimeter) were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full Magyar Bankszövetség member list by iterating tagId on bankszovetseg.hu and reconcile against the MNB institution register, then decide which additional issuers merit a press-room watch.

coverage_gaps.description: Issuer-owned social channels (LinkedIn company pages, YouTube, Facebook) were not scouted, although banks announce appointments and hiring campaigns there first and in Hungarian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the official LinkedIn/Facebook pages of each of the nine banks, but flag them as ToS-restricted: LinkedIn scraping is prohibited, so plan for manual or licensed access only.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom/JSON feed was confirmed for any of the nine press rooms; all collection plans currently assume HTML/PDF scraping.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each press room, probe for /rss, /feed, sitemap.xml and the CMS's native feed endpoint (K&H appears to run Liferay, UniCredit an AEM /content/dam structure, MBH a custom /sw/static store) and record robots.txt constraints per domain.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of each press room (how far back the index paginates) is unknown, so no baseline period for leadership-move rates can be set.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each press room, probe the deepest reachable page/year and record the earliest item date; use the CIB net.cib.hu year-indexed archive as the model for backfill where issuers keep legacy hosts.

brief: The issuer-origin layer for Hungarian leadership and org-change facts is well developed and almost entirely Hungarian-language: every bank in the cell runs a corporate press room (OTP /portal/hu/hirek, MBH /sajtoszoba with date-slugged permalinks, K&H /csoport/kozlemenyek, Erste /hu/sajto/sajtokozlemenyek, Raiffeisen /raiffeisen-csoport/sajtoszoba, CIB /sajtoszoba plus a year-indexed legacy archive on net.cib.hu, UniCredit HU as dated PDFs under a /content/dam path), and each also maintains a diffable governance roster page that catches changes never separately announced. Only OTP, Gránit and MBH Jelzálogbank are listed, so BÉT 'Kibocsátói hírek' and the issuers' own IR pages give a legally timestamped spine for those three, while for the five foreign-owned subsidiaries the binding disclosure sits with the parent group — a structural boundary gap this cell cannot close alone. The 'jobs/hiring' half of the topic set is much thinner at the origin layer: only OTP's own vacancy portal (karrier.otpbank.hu/viewalljobs) was located, leaving eight issuers' employer-owned ATS endpoints unfound and hiring signal at risk of defaulting to third-party job boards. Nothing here was liveness-verified beyond one successful fetch of OTP Group IR, and several paths (Erste's misspelled 'hivatalalos-kozzetetelek' segment, K&H's Liferay portlet URLs, MBH's 2023-dated organigram PDF) are structurally fragile and should be treated as unverified rather than dead if they fail.
